summary: Replaced pre-walk byte-span accountability with canonical structural equivalence decided after the structural walk, and replaced the digit-bounded character-reference decoder with one matching the grammar a renderer applies. All five hidden-byte shapes, the false rejection and all nine residual auto-fetch vectors are closed at the validator, the persistence materializer and the MCP transport, with regressions that fail before and pass after.

acceptance.criterion: AC2 (AFC-02): synthetic secret is absent from JSON, text resource and error; safe JSON passes its schema; a numeric required field carrying a secret returns format-unsafe rather than an invalid string.
acceptance.evidence: Required suite 249 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail (raw 2026-09-06T13-47-15-029Z_run.log), including src/mcp/structural-redaction.test.ts. T24-stage1-probe: secretPropertyName.leaked false, mcpBoundary.secretPropertyNameLeaks false, optionalUndefined non-json-value (raw 2026-09-06T13-48-02-187Z_run.log). Validator probe after: passwordKeyNumericValue format-unsafe / sensitive-numeric-field; the serialized path no longer restores hidden bytes (persistence.escapedDuplicate leakedEscapedBytes true->false, persistence.credentialDuplicate leakedCredential true->false in T36-after-boundary.json).

acceptance.criterion: AC5 (AFC-15): a mixed corpus of safe IDs and real secrets allows no field-name bypass; a URL secret is masked; a public Markdown link is not treated as a network send.
acceptance.evidence: Validator probe f004 after: 33/33 cases correct; nine vectors move flagged false->true with hostStillPresent true->false (zeroPadded8, zeroPadded10, hexZeroPadded7, tabInsideSchemeEntity, literalTabInsideScheme, newlineInsideScheme, leadingSpace, leadingNewline, leadingTabEntity). Controls unchanged: ordinaryPublicLink, bareUrl, relativeImage, dataUriImage, srcsetProtocolLess all unflagged. Transport: mcp.paddedEntityImage and mcp.leadingSpaceImage move from state none / leaksHost true to state redacted / leaksHost false; mcp.publicLink unchanged (T36-after-boundary.json).

acceptance.criterion: Every shape named in the recheck is closed by a regression that fails before and passes after; the public-docs-URL-beside-an-email payload is accepted as redacted; no previously passing case regresses.
acceptance.evidence: New regressions were RED first: 21 pass / 6 fail (raw 2026-09-06T13-45-26-967Z_run.log), then 27 pass / 0 fail / 163 assertions (raw 2026-09-06T13-46-57-688Z_run.log). Covered: JSON-escaped duplicate and its fully escaped variant, duplicate members surviving as empty string / null / false, zero-padded decimal and hexadecimal character references, tab/newline/CR inside the scheme, leading whitespace and an encoded tab before the URL, and the urlThenEmail payload asserted byte-identical to the same value validated as a parsed object. Repository sweep rejections 5 -> 0 over 401 real JSON files. No previously passing case regresses; one committed test's expected verdict changed by design (see concerns).

artifacts.summary: Spec written before coding: why span accountability is structurally wrong, the canonical-equivalence decision rule, the renderer-grammar decoder, and the regression table.
Per-defect root cause, fix and before/after evidence with raw log paths; verification table; concerns; routing audit.

changed_files.change: Removed reachableScalarText and parsedValueAccountsForBytes; added withoutInsignificantWhitespace / bytesAreCanonicalFor and the constant reason serialized-content-normalized; rewrote validateSerializedContentForTransport to decide byte preservation after the structural walk by canonical structural equivalence. serialized-content-mismatch retired.

Rewrote the duplicate-member regression to the new contract and added five regressions: JSON-escaped duplicates, contextual-key duplicates with empty/null/false survivors, serialized-versus-parsed parity for the false-rejection payload, byte preservation for compact and pretty-printed JSON, and structures that must still fail closed.

CHARACTER_REFERENCE now allows unbounded decimal and hexadecimal digit runs with the bound moved onto the code point (MAX_CODE_POINT); added renderableUrl (tab/LF/CR removal plus stripC0OrSpace) and applied it in considerUrl, keeping start/end on the raw span.

Added three regressions: zero-padded decimal and hexadecimal character references, whitespace and control characters inside or before the URL, and benign controls that must stay unflagged under the new decoder.
